changelog: - **Failed deletes no longer report success** (#1355). `confirmDeleteInteraction` on the mentee detail page ignored the DELETE response, so a 403/404/500 still fired the green "Interaction deleted" toast and refetched the list. It now checks `res.ok`, surfaces the reason in an error toast and leaves the row in place. Same unchecked-response fix applied to the portal note delete (`NotesPanel`), the quick Call/WhatsApp contact log (`ContactActions`) and the mentor availability slot delete. New `apiErrorMessage()` helper (`src/lib/apiErrorMessage.ts`) surfaces a 4xx body's `error` and collapses 5xx internals to a localized fallback.

en: A delete or contact log that the server rejects now shows a red error instead of a green "done" — and the record stays visible.
tr: Sunucunun reddettiği bir silme veya iletişim kaydı artık yeşil "tamam" yerine kırmızı hata gösteriyor; kayıt da ekranda kalıyor.
de: Wird ein Löschen oder ein Kontakteintrag vom Server abgelehnt, erscheint jetzt ein roter Fehler statt einer grünen Erfolgsmeldung – und der Eintrag bleibt sichtbar.
